chapter: The Footlight Club and Washington friends
title: Osie Johnson's mother, Charlotte Fillmore, hostess to visiting musicians
summary: Charlotte Fillmore is a civic figure in Washington whose house Clark Terry and Zoot Sims visit.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: So anyone, Osie and I were very good friends. His mother is Charlotte Fillmore, who is the darling of a lot of musicians in New York right now. Clark Terry...
No, I said Clark Terry... His mother.

Osie's mother, who is very much around right now. Whenever Clark Terry or Zoot Sims or a lot of other musicians come to Washington, they go straight to Charlotte Fillmore's house. Or else they call her home, she has them over for dinner and all that. If you ever talk to any of them, if you ask about Charlotte Fillmore, which is Osie Johnson's mother... I am going to call her soon and talk to her. When I do, she'll probably give it to me for not having talked to her since Christmas, because Osie's daughter was here Christmas, and she's sort of a godchild of mine, and I was over... She lives in California now, and she comes home to visit her grandmother. I pick her up at the airport and I go over to see Charlotte. And she always says, 'Where have you been? You've been treating me terrible. You don't come by.' Then she'll go on and tell me all about what's happening in the music world, because she knows what's happening from California to New York, just like I do. Charlotte, Osie's mother, is...I'm sure she's approaching 80. She's somewhere
close to her eightieth birthday, and she gets around as much as anybody in this town! She does a lot of civic work, you know. She's gotten awards from the White House and everything.
